name: BBT-FinT5
description: The Chinese Financial Language understanding and generation Evaluation Benchmark. Inspired by general NLP benchmarks like GLUE, it aggregates six distinct datasets to systematically evaluate the natural language understanding and generation capabilities of pre-trained language models in the Chinese financial domain.
reputation: A foundational domain-specific benchmark that drove the development of early Chinese financial large language models like BBT-FinT5.
notes: Addresses the severe lack of high-quality financial assessment tools in Chinese but leans more toward standard NLP tasks rather than multi-step symbolic/numeric financial calculation.
